title: yan/hypergsd-trashbin
cpl.author: Yannis Anthymidis
cpl.description: Trash completed items via kookma's Trashbin instead of deleting
cpl.name: HyperGSD Trashbin
cpl.title: yan/hypergsd-trashbin
cpl.readme:
A sub-plugin of [[HyperGSD|$:/plugins/yan/hypergsd]] that adds a button to move completed items to the trashbin, instead of deleting them outright.
Depends on Mohammad Rahmani's Trashbin ([[$:/plugins/kookma/trashbin]]).

By default, the trashbin button will coexist with the regular <button disabled>{{$:/core/images/delete-button}} {{$:/language/Buttons/Delete/Caption}}</button> button.
To hide the standard <button disabled>{{$:/core/images/delete-button}} {{$:/language/Buttons/Delete/Caption}}</button> button, open [[$:/plugins/yan/hypergsd/ui/list-items/delete]] and untag <<tag $:/tags/hypergsd/Fragment/Row/Suffix>>, or just press this button: <$button>hide {{$:/core/images/delete-button}} {{$:/language/Buttons/Delete/Caption}} button<$action-listops $tiddler="$:/plugins/yan/hypergsd/ui/list-items/delete" $tags="-[[$:/tags/hypergsd/Fragment/Row/Suffix]]" /></$button>
